mapper.sql: company.id AS id, company.code AS code, company.name AS name, company.is_deleted AS is_deleted, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departments department WHERE department.company_id = company.id ) AS department_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users user_account WHERE user_account.company_id = company.id ) AS user_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requests request_record WHERE request_record.company_id = company.id ) AS request_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assets asset WHERE asset.company_id = company.id ) AS asset_count
mapper.select:
SELECT , company.updated_at AS updated_at FROM companies company WHERE 1 = 1
AND company.is_deleted = FALSE
ORDER BY company.code ASC, company.id ASC

SELECT , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generic_master_values master_value WHERE master_value.company_id = company.id ) AS generic_master_value_count, company.created_at AS created_at, company.updated_at AS updated_at FROM companies company WHERE company.id = #{companyId}

SELECT , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generic_master_values master_value WHERE master_value.company_id = company.id ) AS generic_master_value_count, company.created_at AS created_at, company.updated_at AS updated_at FROM companies company WHERE company.id = #{companyId} AND company.is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO companies ( code, name, is_deleted, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{name}, FALSE, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT generic_master.id FROM generic_master WHERE generic_master.code = #{code} AND generic_master.is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generic_master_values ( generic_master_id, company_id, code, name, sort_order, is_deleted, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{genericMasterId}, #{companyId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{sortOrder}, FALSE, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generic_master_values master_value INNER JOIN generic_master master ON master.id = master_value.generic_master_id AND master.code = #{genericMasterCode} AND master.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE master_value.company_id = #{companyId}
